name: Generic Email Connector (SMTP)

requiredEnvironmentVariables.purpose: Hostname of the SMTP server for outbound communication
TLS/STARTTLS port number for the SMTP server
Secure app password or SMTP authentication key

exactSetupSteps: 1. Create or update the local '.env' file in project root 'C:\Users\hp\OneDrive\GARUDA\GARUDA-AI\.env'.
2. Add the four required environment variables: GARUDA_EMAIL_HOST, GARUDA_EMAIL_PORT, GARUDA_EMAIL_USER, GARUDA_EMAIL_PASS.
3. Save the file. Ensure '.env' remains git-ignored (verified in .gitignore).
4. Re-run validation via API endpoint GET /api/revenue/connectors/generic_email/auth or node test script.
validationMethod: Call platformAuth.validateConnectorAuthentication('generic_email', process.env) to perform local shape and readiness validation.
note: Even when configured, GARUDA will require separate explicit Founder authorization before executing any live external action.
